notes: Separate actor mode, opposite mode, fixture, seed cohort and exact identity. Do not pool all snapshots into a global percentile.
Shared-opponent history uses one selected cohort per exact model; cross-seed/round deltas are descriptive.
Old conditional first-big timings use purchased printed4–5VP coverage denominator, never all-game mean.
